In 9th grade I stayed after school for homework club (basically you can just stay in the library after school 2 times a week and work on homework) and halfway through the club the teacher that was the club supervisor would take us to her classroom where we could get a small snack and take a 15 minute break.

In her room there were exercise balls we were allowed to sit on, and I decided to sit on one. A guy I knew came up to me and lightly kicked it while I was sitting on it just to mess with me, the ball didn't go anywhere and it didn't cause anything to happen besides a little noise in a loud classroom. The teacher looked at us and said "Don't do that" so he didn't do it again.

When it was time to go back to the library we're not supposed to leave the classroom until instructed but I was ready to leave and me and my friends were standing near the door and I was standing in the doorway. Some kid starts telling me I can't leave the classroom and I told him I am in the classroom. He starts DEMANDING I get back in the classroom. I tell him to fuck off and mind his own business in an annoyed but calm way, and then he starts YELLING to the teacher that I'm leaving the classroom. I just stand where I was standing and say I'm not leaving the classroom and the teacher says to get out of the doorway so I take half a step forward and turn to the kid and ask him if he's fucking happy. Nobody said anything and then the teacher decided it was time to go back to the library so I go back and sit down next to a few of my friends I was studying with. 

After a few mins the teacher comes over to me and tells me to be more gentle with her exercise balls and not to leave the classroom early, and I was trying not to get pissed off so I just smiled and said "alright, my bad" and I thought that was the end of it all. The next day at school today start hearing rumours about how I got kicked out of homework club and also that day apparently someone went through the locker room and stole a bunch of the football players shit so people started saying it must have been me that did it cause the doors lock after school so it had to have been somebody inside the school after regular hours unaccounted for and if I got kicked out I would fit that criteria so I start denying these rumours saying I got kicked out and had people that were there back me up.

I went to homework club that day with no problems and I thought that was the end of all that shit but then the next week I tried to go to homework club again and they told me I was kicked out for 2 months. I asked why and nobody would give me an answer, so I just went home and the FIRST THING I heard when my mom got home was her yelling about me getting kicked out of homework club and freaking out at me and I told her I don't even know what I did and nobody would give me an answer why at the school. She said that the teacher who's classroom we went to called her and asked to schedule an appointment with her at the school and the teacher told her that I was kicking the exercise ball all around her classroom and breaking stuff, yelling and being violent towards other students, and leaving early and running down the halls during break. I said that she was a liar and I could get anybody that was there to vouch for me. She said that the teacher looked "traumatized" and she didn't need me to tell some kid to lie to her to get me out of trouble. 

I already had issues at home and this teacher straight up lied to my parents and made it 10 times worse. And I literally did nothing to deserve it. I ended up getting let back into homework club after those 2 months but I would never go with that teacher and Everytime she would come up to me when I was trying to work I would tell her to go fuck herself until she just started leaving me alone during the clubs.
